source_instruction: i am looking for resealable snak club antioxidant trail mix. 5.5oz packs of six.
query: Ugh, I just realized I left my favorite lavender-infused iced coffee sitting on the kitchen counter right by the toaster when I ran out the door this morning, and I’m already kicking myself because I spent three whole minutes last night brewing it extra strong and stirring in just the right amount of oat milk to get that creamy, not-too-sweet ratio I’ve been perfecting for weeks. The barista at the corner spot by the bus stop always over-roasts their beans so bad every sip tastes like burnt campfire ash, and I really don’t want to drop seven bucks on a drink I know I’ll hate just because I was scatterbrained before leaving. I also spotted the fluffiest orange tabby cat curled up on the hood of a beat-up blue pickup in the parking lot when I walked in, it had a tiny white patch on its chest that looked like a tiny lopsided heart, and I stopped to give it a couple quick scratches behind the ears before it hopped down to trot after a sparrow that darted under a nearby shopping cart return. Hey, can you help me grab something from the dried fruits & raisins section? I need it to come in a microwaveable steamer bag, be that one size I always get, and make sure it’s certified kosher for Passover too. Oh, and don’t grab anything over $40, please.
